properties.name: axiz.audit.mode
properties.description: Canonical audit delivery mode: DURABLE requires transactional outbox; ASYNC uses an in-memory queue; SYNC confirms delivery before returning.

deprecation.reason: Legacy mode selector; removal in 3.0. Migrate the effective configuration as a whole, preserving DURABLE precedence.
Legacy mode selector; removal in 3.0. Queue settings remain supported; do not migrate independently of durable.enabled.

properties.name: axiz.audit.kafka.send-workers
properties.description: Dedicated Kafka send workers; positive. Send admission never runs on the reactive caller.

properties.name: axiz.audit.kafka.send-queue-capacity
properties.description: Additional admission capacity beyond workers. Total pending submissions plus unacknowledged sends is bounded by workers plus queue capacity; saturation rejects immediately.
